## makeVideo

``` python

def makeVideo(
    timeseries:dict, # One or more mappings `{subject: (array, ...)}` providing the data used to generate the animation. Each subject entry must contain a 2‑D array.
    percentile_ts:dict | None=None, # Mapping containing lower/upper percentile time series used for highlighting temperature percentiles in the animation.
    interval:tuple=(0, 200), # Start and end times of the video segment in seconds (relative to the audio).
    interval_shift:int=0, # Shift applied to the interval relative to the audio file's zero‑time.
    feature:NoneType=None, # Feature matrix indexed by time with subjects as columns.
    subj:int | list[int]=2, # Subject index or list of indices to include in the animation.
    title:str='', # Title used to name the output video file.
): # Saves the final video to `<videopath>/aa{title}.mp4`.

```

*Create a video by combining an animation generated from one or more
time series* with an audio segment extracted from the cached audio file.
